baseline.title: Always allowed (protected)
baseline.description: Computed fresh every time — SSH, every VPN instance's listening port, and the panel's own ports if this is the panel host. These can never be blocked, regardless of your rules below.

actions.rollbackConfirmTitle: Roll back immediately? This restores the pre-apply ruleset right away.

dryRun.title: Dry-run preview
dryRun.note: Nothing has changed on the server yet — this only previews and validates.

applyConfirm.title: Apply firewall rules?
applyConfirm.description: This takes effect immediately. If it breaks connectivity (including to the panel itself), it auto-reverts after {{secs}} seconds unless you confirm.

countdown.title: New rules active — reverts automatically in {{secs}}s unless confirmed
countdown.panelReachableFailed: Panel LOST SSH access — will auto-revert
